how_the_pieces_are_cut.rule: at a read made at the moment M a trade received at R is inside while M minus R is less than 20 seconds; it is in the piece numbered by the whole seconds of M minus R, counted back from the read, and the operator is given the pieces oldest first. Nothing is cut on the clock.
how_the_pieces_are_cut.which_trades: a read made at a trade holds every trade with a side up to and including that one on the tape; a read of trades leaving holds no trade received after its moment. A trade the tape gives no side for is in neither list. Sizes are lots.

columns.what: The number of the read of the stored exhaustion line this line belongs to.
The moment of that read on the received clock, to the nanosecond.
What changed the stored line at that read: a trade was received, or trades left the span.
The trade received: its position on the tape. Empty when the read is trades leaving.
Size bought inside the 20 seconds after this read, as stored (the bought pieces add up to it).
Size sold inside the 20 seconds after this read, as stored (the sold pieces add up to it).
The operator's first figure: bought minus sold over bought plus sold, over the twenty pieces. Checked equal to the stored exhaustion line at every read.
The entropy of the twenty bought pieces minus the entropy of the twenty sold pieces, over their sum. An entropy here is of the sizes sorted into classes, as the operator does it.
THE INFORMATION RATIO: the mean of the two entropies over the information the two lists share, signed by the side that leads. Huge where the two lists share nothing: made by the division.
The shared information of the later ten pieces minus that of the earlier ten, signed by the side that leads.
The lean (bought minus sold over bought plus sold) of the later ten pieces minus the lean of the earlier ten.
Codex's form of the ratio: its sign times the logarithm of one plus its size.
The information the twenty bought pieces and the twenty sold pieces share (the bottom of the ratio before the operator's smallest number is added).
How many of the twenty pieces hold any buying.
How many of the twenty pieces hold any selling.
How many of the twenty pieces hold any trade with a side.
